admission.policy: source pair admitted only when generation disposition is PAIRED, both variants are finite, both have T >= 64, channel count equals 6 and lineage config/generator identity matches; admission never uses labels or encoder outputs

branches.when: coverage invalid or any readout invalid or run incomplete
RAW qualifies and both learned readouts fail

decision.tie_break: pooled first because it is the already-deployed readout; pre-pooling second because it changes only aggregation; raw is never a keep outcome because it bypasses the learned representation

forecast.assumptions: forward rate is the measured M18 whole-matrix rate (generation+capture+scoring); waveform byte estimate assumes the plan mean step count and 15% npz overhead; disk must be re-checked at the explicit --out before capture
forecast.cpu_permutations_note: no permutation cell matrix; thresholds are pre-registered order statistics of 300 calibration windows

gates.aggregation: unweighted macro over the 27 family x severity cells
gates.duration_guard: all nine families must clear the family floor; the eight non-duration families must clear 0.80
gates.encoder_robustness: >=2 of 3 encoders individually pass the same FPR/detection/family/non-duration gates
gates.encoder_rule: majority-of-3 (>=2 of 3 frozen encoders exceed their own calibrated threshold)
gates.intervals: Clopper-Pearson per cell and per horizon, reported with the finite calibration-tail uncertainty
gates.monotonicity: detection(0.275) >= detection(0.15) >= control rate, point estimates, per horizon

geometry.choice: week 40 and month 160 are selected from the inherited week-{40,60} and month-{160,250} candidates because 4 x 40 = 160 preserves the exact nested monthly composition; week-60 would not map onto either inherited monthly size
geometry.implications: smaller windows carry fewer absolute faults (2/6/11 weekly, 8/24/44 monthly) and less precision than the 60/250 candidates; the exact counts are frozen and the finite-sample intervals are reported

historical_records: accepted M17/M18/M19 contracts, caches and reports remain immutable

labels_vs_causal.evidence: label-blind movement, planned membership, exact denominators and calibrated finite-sample gates

limitations.dependence: weekly and monthly windows of one episode share sources and calendar context; within-horizon windows across episodes have disjoint physical sources; six histories are clusters, not independent populations
limitations.labels: labels are used only for planned membership accounting and post-hoc evaluation; the movement statistic is label-blind and no labelswap test is assumed
limitations.no_pseudo_n: one item per file; long files with many patches contribute exactly one item and one equal weight; patch counts are diagnostics only
non_claims: finite synthetic benchmark engineering targets, never a business SLA
movement is an association in this corpus, never a causal mechanism
a miss is never evidence of population absence or of no signal
the reference population is a fixed finite conditioning set; results are conditional on it
history-level dependence is disclosed; six histories are not six independent populations
duration is one of nine families and can never qualify a readout alone
labels are construction/evaluation metadata; the statistic is label-blind
no encoder training, refit, fine-tuning, checkpoint change or Phase C action
limitations.reference_conditioning: every statistic conditions on one fixed finite reference population per history; results do not generalize to a different reference draw
limitations.scientific: any burden-arm difference is an association in this finite synthetic benchmark, not a causal mechanism and not evidence of absence
limitations.source_identity: source identity is the physical generation key, not the planned index: reference and bandwidth sources are keyed by their normal seed and calibration/test sources by the first derived normal seed of their pair seed; the census covers every active role, history and episode slot exactly once, so a repeated twin/variant or a repeated weekly/monthly window is one logical source and is never counted as independent

membership.monthly_derivation: month = union of the four weekly block compositions (same sources)
membership.realized_burden: faults admitted / files admitted; requested and realized values are both published
membership.rule: admission is applied to the generated source pair before membership; admitted sources are hash-ordered within each block with null seed 2407; the first ceil(burden*block) ranks are abnormal; 5% is a subset of 15%, which is a subset of 27.5%; no redraw and no rebalancing

namespaces.bandwidth: normal-only pool used only for kernel bandwidth
namespaces.reference: normal-only population used in every statistic and for standardization
namespaces.rule: disjoint source-index bands per history plus a frozen physical-source key allocation over the exact active census; no file, physical source, episode or window is shared by independent roles, and the twin/variant plus the weekly and monthly windows of one episode remain one logical source
namespaces.test: held-out control and nested-episode windows used only for the gates

LENGTH.role: diagnostic only; never a primary success and never able to qualify a readout alone

POOLED.item: 128-d frozen encoder file_embedding (mean of valid patch context latents)
POOLED.source: accepted frozen checkpoint/bank as-is; deterministic Sprint18 mask seed

PREPOOL.item: 128-d per-file first two moments of the frozen-encoder pre-pooling context latents in a random-Fourier-feature space (64 RFF mean + 64 RFF std)
PREPOOL.kernel: Gaussian RFF, D=64, frozen draw seed 2407, bandwidth from the independent bandwidth pool
PREPOOL.limitation: only the exact per-file sufficient statistic is stored; alternative patch kernels are not recomputable
PREPOOL.source: context_latents restricted to patch_valid_mask; equal file weight (one item per file)

RAW.item: 85-d deterministic whole-file patch_features (channel level/RMS/std/slope/min/max, cross-channel corr/mean-diff, spectral low/high, max step, valid fraction)
RAW.module: representation.handcrafted.patch_features over the full valid file
RAW.source: actual waveform only; labels, masks and encoder outputs never enter

allocation.resolver: canonical order (role reference<bandwidth<calibration<test, then history, then plan episode order, then slot); the first claimant of a physical-source key keeps its planned index and seed; every later claimant probes its dedicated index namespace probe_base+row*max_probes+attempt until the derived seed yields an unused key; no outcome, label or encoder state enters the resolver

source_identity.cross_domain: equal integers in the normal and paired domains do not share a clean stream, because the two constructors draw different streams; both domains are nevertheless keyed in one namespace through their own clean keys, so any real stream reuse is caught
source_identity.logical_source: one row per (role, history, episode, slot); the twin and its variant are the same logical source, and the weekly and monthly windows of one episode reuse the same sources — they are counted once, never as independent occurrences

normal_domain.key: the derived 31-bit seed itself: NormalGenerator.generate draws its whole stream from default_rng(seed)

paired_domain.key: normal_seed = int(default_rng(pair_seed).integers(0, 2**31)), the first draw of SessionGenerator._anomaly_source; the fleet, regimes, gain/offset, causal stream, noise seed, twin and group/source ids all derive from it
paired_domain.why_not_the_pair_seed: two distinct pair seeds with the same normal_seed generate byte-identical twins while their group_id/source_id/file ids differ; integer-seed uniqueness alone is therefore not proof of source disjointness

statistic.bandwidth: median pairwise Euclidean distance on the standardized independent bandwidth pool
statistic.calibration: threshold = order statistic ceil(q*N_cal)-1 (0-based, ascending) of the calibration-window statistic; q=0.975; N_cal=300 per horizon
statistic.formula: 2/(n*m) sum_ij k(w_i,r_j) - 1/(n(n-1)) sum_{i!=j} k(w_i,w_j) - 1/(m(m-1)) sum_{i!=j} k(r_i,r_j), k(x,y)=exp(-||x-y||^2/(2*sigma^2))
statistic.standardization: per-readout center/scale fitted on the reference population only

storage.results: design.json, contract.json, run.json, statistics.json, decision.json, replay.json
storage.role: items.npz is the exact sufficient statistic for every readout; waveforms.npz is custody
storage.root: <explicit --out; fresh directory, never a scanned mount>

supersedes.reason: the A01 allocation kept disjoint source indices but 25 logical sources shared a physical generation key (13 planned indices derived the same 31-bit pair seed and 12 distinct pair seeds resolved to the same clean source), including calibration-test groups; A02 freezes a collision-free physical-source allocation over the same plan
supersedes.scientific_scope: counts, windows, burdens, readouts, calibration, gates, decision rules and non-claims are unchanged; only the source-identity assignment is corrected
